decisions.reason: As a niche, experimental extension of the firm's physical-media offer, it is worth keeping open for another year because learning value is still present and online catalog carrying costs are likely modest, even though its test character raises the chance of exit if demand remains thin.

Because this compilation series is close to the firm's core catalog, fits its collector audience, and can be sustained at relatively low incremental cost while demand is still being revealed, management would likely keep it on the market.
